completed.title: Harden plugin manifest metadata against log/UI control-sequence injection
completed.threat_model: A malicious or compromised plugin can place CR/LF, C0/C1 controls or Unicode bidi/format controls in publisher metadata so future logs, diagnostics or UI surfaces visually spoof trusted metadata, inject lines, or conceal text direction.
completed.result: Plugin manifest display-facing strings and publisher metadata now fail closed on Unicode Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp categories, covering C0/C1 controls, CR/LF-style injection, bidi/format controls and Unicode line/paragraph separators. No plugin execution or remote surface was introduced.
